5. Main Controller Top 
5.1. Description of Main Controller 
The Main Controller is in charge of generating and receiving all the control signals for the Analog 
Domain, furthermore, performs DSP elaboration on ADC Output and writes it in different 
Address. This block IP is divided into different sub-blocks, all at the same hierarchy level and 
described in the next chapter. Together with the Analog Domain, this block is interfaced with the 
FIFO Controller, the ADSP and the PMU, these last two will not be described in this document. 
The block IP is divided into different sub-blocks, all at the same hierarchy level and described in 
the next chapter.

3. 3 ECG channels (ECG0 + ECG1 + ECG3) 
4. BIA channel 
5. GSR channel 
6. PPG channel

5.3.2. Description of the Block 
This block is divided into two FSMs. The first FSM called Device_FSM, is in charge of identify the 
working state of the device. The second FSM called Elab_FSM, is in charge of identify what signal 
is in elaboration and to check and generate signal from and for the Analog Domain. The Elab_FSM 
is also in charge to start writing to the AHB Crossbar and to talk with Hardware DSPs block like 
the Avarage Circuit and ADSP, or to start PPG operation talking with the PPG_FSM. This Block is 
also in charge to turn of the Fast Ring Oscillator (16 MHz) and to enable the User Read Operation.

5.11.4. PPG Frame Repetition 
The frame repetition is a classic mean operation between two 20 bit PPG data. The result of the 
frame is accumulated on a 24 bit accumulator that is divided by the number of repeated frame. 
The number of repetition frames supported is 0 (no frame repetead), 2,4 and 8. 
5.11.4.1. Requirements 
[IPOS_STBIO1_MAIN_CONTROLLER_ 2145] REQUIREMENT : 
The Frame shall work as follows: 
1. Select how many times a particular frame shall be repeated 
2. The result of each repetition shall be obtained as explained in 
[IPOS_STBIO1_MAIN_CONTROLLER_1 40] REQUIREMENT  
3. After the last repetition has been accumulated, the data output shall be obtained dividing 
by the number of repeated frames the accumulated data to obtain a 20 bit data. 
The final result shall be computed as follows:
